producer_report.summary: The verifier prompt (crates/athena-context/prompts/verifier.md) now says its working directory is a snapshot, not the real repository. It has no records/, owner files or history, so anything run there is a result about the snapshot only. When a command depends on records/ or another absent path, the verifier must say so explicitly in evidence and findings, and never report it as a result on the real repository. The root cause was that the prompt never told the verifier what its snapshot lacked. A new unit test in athena-context checks that VERIFIER_FRAME contains the five key phrases, so removing the rule fails the test. The verifier set was at its token budget, so I made small wording cuts elsewhere in that prompt to pay for the addition. I also added a CHANGELOG entry and a revision note under D12 in docs/decisions.md. Format, clippy and the full test suite all pass.

checks_run.note: all suites pass, including the budgets test and the new test

open_issues: I did not touch briefs.rs or crates/athena-cap-change/prompts/verifier.md. Both are listed as deliverables but the root-cause fix did not need them: the verifier frame carries the rule, and the brief's Working directory section is the producer's.
The rule is prose. Nothing checks verdicts for false claims, as the brief says.
mistakes: My first draft of the rule was too long and pushed the verifier set over its token budget. My first decisions.md edit added lines and broke the backtest tests. I fixed both.
learnings: The verifier role set budget is 1300 estimated tokens and was nearly full; any prompt addition has to be paid for by trimming other prompt text.

docs/decision-links.toml keys confirmed links by line number in docs/decisions.md. Adding or removing lines in that file breaks two backtest tests unless the toml is updated, so I edited within the existing line count.
desires: A way to see the verifier token budget headroom without running the whole test suite.
